import openpyxl
import os
from copy import copy

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/458-49/1_458-49_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/458-49_0_38d3ec9e/1_458-49_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Imported Data"]

# Allowed modification range: A1:C53
start_row, end_row = 1, 53
start_col, end_col = 1, 3

# Keep header row and all rows from row 2 onward where Column C does NOT end with 'L'
kept_rows = []
kept_styles = []

for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    row_values = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1)]
    row_styles = []
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        row_styles.append({
            "font": copy(cell.font),
            "fill": copy(cell.fill),
            "border": copy(cell.border),
            "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
            "number_format": cell.number_format,
            "protection": copy(cell.protection)
        })

    if r == 1:
        kept_rows.append(row_values)
        kept_styles.append(row_styles)
    else:
        col_c_value = ws.cell(r, 3).value
        if col_c_value is None or not str(col_c_value).rstrip().endswith("L"):
            kept_rows.append(row_values)
            kept_styles.append(row_styles)

# Clear only the permitted range A1:C53
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(r, c).value = None

# Write filtered data back into the permitted range
for idx, row_values in enumerate(kept_rows, start=start_row):
    if idx > end_row:
        break
    for offset, value in enumerate(row_values, start=start_col):
        cell = ws.cell(idx, offset)
        cell.value = value

        style = kept_styles[idx - start_row][offset - start_col]
        cell.font = copy(style["font"])
        cell.fill = copy(style["fill"])
        cell.border = copy(style["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy(style["alignment"])
        cell.number_format = style["number_format"]
        cell.protection = copy(style["protection"])

# Ensure output directory exists and save
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
